info.name: Rice Age Portal API
info.description:
Department-scoped portal API for the Rice Age IoT rice quality and age analyser.

42 implemented operations across 15 folders, generated from the running FastAPI application's OpenAPI document. See postman/POSTMAN_API_GUIDE.md for setup, the human-vs-device authentication difference and the safe test-data workflow.

All outputs are advisory: optical estimates are not statutory procurement measurements and the portal is not a certification authority.

item.name: 1. Health & Readiness
item.description: Unauthenticated probes. Readiness performs a real database round-trip.

request.description: Returns the service identity. Version and environment are omitted in production.
200 when PostgreSQL answers SELECT 1; 503 dependency_unavailable otherwise.

item.name: 2. Authentication
item.description: Human authentication. The access token is a bearer JWT (15 min default); the refresh token is an HttpOnly cookie (`ra_refresh`, path /api/v1/auth) and is never returned in the body, so Postman must keep cookies enabled. Devices use a different flow (folder 7).

request.description: Seeded development account (dev_seed.py). Replace with your own account.
Stores the token in user_access_token; the collection default stays on the admin.
Super-admin cookies overwrite the admin refresh cookie, so sign in as super last or use a separate Postman tab when you need to switch back.
Requires the ra_refresh cookie. Rotation is single-use: replaying an old cookie returns 401 invalid_refresh.
Re-reads the principal from the database, so deactivation is immediate.
Ends every other session for the account and clears the refresh cookie. Disabled by default; set enable_password_change=true against a disposable database.

item.name: 3. Department Administration
item.description: Department creation and edits are super-admin only; department admins may read their own.

item.name: 4. User Administration
item.description: Interim DR-019 policy: a department admin manages users inside their own department and can never grant super-admin status.

request.description: Deactivating a user revokes all of their sessions.

item.name: 5. Device Administration
item.description: Registration, edits and credential lifecycle are super-admin only. A device secret is returned exactly once, at issue or rotate time.

request.description: Registration also creates the first active assignment.
Returns client_id and client_secret once. 409 credential_exists when one is active.

item.description: Ownership history is append-only: reassignment closes the previous row and never moves scans that were already accepted.

item.name: 7. IoT Device APIs
item.description: Machine identity only. Obtain a token with client_credentials, then use it as a bearer token. A human token on these routes returns 403 user_token_used_on_device_route.

request.description: Idempotency key is (device_id, client_scan_id). Department is taken from the authenticated device's active assignment; a payload department_id is rejected.

exec: // Each run submits a fresh client_scan_id unless reuse_scan is set to 'true',
// so the full submit -> upload -> finalize lifecycle stays repeatable.
pm.test('first submission is not a replay', () => pm.expect(body.replayed).to.eql(false));

request.description: Same bytes, same client_scan_id: safe replay, no duplicate scan or notification.
Same client_scan_id, different bytes: rejected instead of silently overwriting.
A unit that does not match its measurement basis fails schema validation.

request.description: Binary body: select postman/samples/platen-bottom.png in the Postman UI (its hash is in the environment). This file cannot be sent as text.
top_image is optional under the provisional attachment policy (DR-007) and is not required by finalize. Preparing it without uploading leaves an unverified row, which is fine.
Verifies required attachments, applies the device-supplied verdict and creates deduplicated notifications. Required roles are configuration (default report_pdf,bottom_image).

item.name: 8. Scan Management
item.description: Portal reads of one scan and its report. Department scope is resolved server-side; a super admin must pass ?department_id=.

request.description: 204 means the department has no completed scan yet. In-flight or failed scans are never returned here.

exec: pm.test('200 with a scan or 204 when empty', () =>

request.description: Binary stream of the original device PDF. The access token travels in the header; no public URL is issued.

item.name: 9. Scan History
item.description: Paginated, department-scoped history. Supported filters: batch_code, device_id, processing_status, quality_verdict, start_date, end_date, page, per_page.

item.name: 10. Quality Analytics
item.description: Counts and per-basis parameter statistics. Values are grouped by basis + unit and are never blended across incompatible bases.

item.name: 11. Rice Age Analytics
item.description: Device-supplied age only. Missing age is null, never zero; a scan with no age row is simply absent from the list.

item.name: 12. Reports
item.description: Listing of scans with report/age availability. Download uses folder 8's report endpoints.

item.name: 13. Batch Comparison
item.description: Scans grouped by batch_code with measurements grouped by basis; count and estimated-mass percentages stay separate.

item.name: 14. Notifications
item.description: In-portal notifications for the signed-in user, scoped to their department. There is no mark-as-read endpoint yet; read_at is reported but cannot be changed through the API.

item.name: 15. Department Isolation & Security Checks
item.description: Negative paths that prove the server, not the UI, is the access boundary. Audit has no HTTP read endpoint yet, so there is no audit folder.
